title: Reproducible analysis code for Testing cortical-state persistence as a dynamical mechanism of freezing of gait
description: Frozen reproducibility release for the resubmission of manuscript rsif-2026-0121 to Journal of the Royal Society Interface. The code analyses the public Mendeley Data version-3 multimodal freezing-of-gait dataset and evaluates concurrent cortical spectral associations, continuous versus discretized representations, prospective cortical-state persistence, and strictly antecedent theta/low-beta dynamics before freezing onset.
